title: Avoidant attachment, as a textbook describes the reunion pattern
summary: OpenStax says avoidant attachment is an unresponsive pattern: the child does not use the parent as a base and does not seem to care if the parent leaves.
body: In OpenStax Psychology's account of the Strange Situation, avoidant attachment means the child is unresponsive to the parent, does not use the parent as a secure base, and does not care if the parent leaves. The toddler reacts to the parent in the same way as to a stranger, and is slow to show a positive reaction when the parent returns. Ainsworth's theory, as the page states it, was that these children were most likely to have a caregiver who was insensitive and inattentive. That is a research interpretation of a lab pattern. It is not a judgment this card makes about any household.
